raw_findings.issue: Use ternary operator instead of if-else-block for salt assignment
raw_findings.fix: salt = want_bytes(salt) if salt is not None else b"itsdangerous.Signer"

architecture.summary: ItsDangerous is a Python library providing various helpers to pass data to untrusted environments and get it back safe and sound by cryptographically signing it. It allows developers to serialize, compress, and sign data with optional timestamps to ensure tokens are not tampered with or expired. Developed by the Pallets organization, it supports features like key rotation, URL-safe serialization, and custom signing algorithms.

modules.name: itsdangerous.__init__
modules.purpose: Exposes the public API of the library including serializers, signers, and exceptions.

modules.name: itsdangerous.encoding
modules.purpose: Provides helper functions for base64 encoding/decoding and byte/integer conversions.

modules.name: itsdangerous.exc
modules.purpose: Defines custom exception classes for handling bad signatures, expired timestamps, and invalid data.

modules.name: itsdangerous.serializer
modules.purpose: Handles serializing data structures (via JSON by default) and wrapping signers.

modules.name: itsdangerous.signer
modules.purpose: Provides cryptographic signing using HMAC algorithms and token verification.

modules.name: itsdangerous.timed
modules.purpose: Extends signers and serializers with timestamp recording and signature expiration validation.

modules.name: itsdangerous.url_safe
modules.purpose: Provides URL-safe serializers and timed serializers with optional zlib compression.

modules.name: itsdangerous._json
modules.purpose: Internal helper module providing a compact JSON encoder and decoder wrapper.
